Subject: Poland
Best Source: KOWR Rejestr działalności w zakresie wyrobu lub rozlewu napojów spirytusowych — https://www.gov.pl/web/kowr/prowadzenie-rejestru-dzialalnosci-w-zakresie-wyrobu-lub-rozlewu-napojow-spirytusowych
Access Method: public search — Public government regulatory register queried via web interface and official directory listings.
Use Caveat: The registry includes legally licensed commercial spirit producers and bottlers, though certain artisanal or exempt small-scale agricultural distillers may require cross-referencing with CEIDG and KRS business registries.
Local Query Terms: wyrób napojów spirytusowych; destylowanie, rektyfikowanie i mieszanie alkoholi; rejestr producentów napojów spirytusowych
Site-Level Suitability: High — Official regulatory and business filings explicitly record the exact operational production site addresses and registered headquarters of licensed distillers.

Subject: Czech Republic
Access Method: public search — Free online search interface and API querying official government economic registers by CZ-NACE classification code.
Use Caveat: While ARES provides comprehensive coverage of all registered Czech business entities, specific operational distillery permits must be verified against Ministry of Agriculture records.
Local Query Terms: pěstitelská pálenice; ovocný lihovar; výroba lihovin
Site-Level Suitability: High — The registry records exact physical addresses and registered establishment locations for all legal distilling producers.

Subject: Slovakia
Best Source: Finančná správa (Financial Administration of the Slovak Republic) — https://www.financnasprava.sk
Access Method: public search — Public online search interface providing access to excise tax registrations, tax warehouses, and authorized distilling operations.
Use Caveat: Data access is available via public web searches and official lists, but automated bulk extraction requires navigating portal search forms or commercial register queries.
Site-Level Suitability: High — Official administrative and tax registers record the exact physical operational addresses and distillery plant locations of licensed alcohol producers.

Subject: Hungary
Best Source: Nemzeti Adó- és Vámhivatal (NAV) Engedélyes és nyilvántartott jövedéki alanyok — https://nav.gov.hu/adatbazisok/jovedekei_engedelyesek_1417768231425
Access Method: bulk download — Public search and downloadable CSV/Excel dataset provided directly by the national tax authority portal.
Use Caveat: The dataset contains all excise-licensed entities across alcohol, tobacco, and energy sectors, requiring filtering by activity or tax warehouse type to isolate spirit distilleries.
Site-Level Suitability: High — The registry provides precise physical addresses of licensed tax warehouses and production plants.

Subject: Romania
Best Source: Oficiul Național al Registrului Comerțului (ONRC) — https://www.onrc.ro
Access Method: manual directory — Public query via ONRC portal and official commercial registers using NACE/CAEN code 1101 for spirit distillation.
Use Caveat: While ONRC provides official company registration and address details, full extract reports and certified historical certificates involve nominal fees and manual lookup per entity.
Site-Level Suitability: High — Official business registry entries record exact registered operational headquarters and distillery production site addresses.

Subject: Bulgaria
Access Method: public search — manual directory and web portal search of excise tax warehouses and licensed distilleries under the Excise Duties and Tax Warehouses Act
Use Caveat: The public registers are accessed primarily through portal web searches rather than structured bulk downloads or APIs.
Local Query Terms: специализиран малък обект за дестилация; дестилерия; производство на ракия
Site-Level Suitability: High — Excise licensing and customs registers mandate registration of the exact physical address where distillation and storage equipment operate.

Subject: Croatia
Access Method: public search — Online public search portal providing free access to official corporate records and registered business activities.
Use Caveat: Official corporate registration data is publicly accessible and legally reliable, but filtering specifically for craft distillers requires manual review of individual company filings as bulk NACE code exports are not directly downloadable through the public interface.
Local Query Terms: destilerija; proizvodnja jakih alkoholnih pića; rakija; viljamovka; slivovica; liker
Site-Level Suitability: Medium — Identifies the official registered corporate headquarters and legal seats of distilling entities, but may not independently detail secondary physical production plants or farm-gate distilleries without examining full registry extracts.

Subject: Slovenia
Access Method: public search — Free online search through the ePRS portal by company name, registration number, or activity code (SKD) without mandatory sign-up.
Use Caveat: The registry covers all officially registered commercial entities and business units, but small-scale artisanal or household distillers operating strictly informally or under agricultural exemptions may not appear under commercial distillation classification codes without cross-referencing agricultural sideline activity records.
Site-Level Suitability: High — The register provides exact physical business and operational addresses for every registered entity and production unit location.

Subject: Serbia
Access Method: public search — Publicly accessible web list and database maintained by the Ministry of Agriculture for active spirits producers.
Use Caveat: The registry is subject to periodic maintenance updates and requires compliance with Serbian public information regulations.
Local Query Terms: registar proizvođača jakih alkoholnih pića; rakija; voćna rakija
Site-Level Suitability: High — The register includes detailed physical address and production facility location data for licensed commercial distillers.
